newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices fall, overseas buying sluggish.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices fall, overseas buying sluggish.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Tuesday fell to 1,087/1,088 rupees per quintal from 1,092/1,093 rupees on sluggish overseas buying, dealers said.
They said sentiment remained subdued but technically now market is oversold and shortcovering may help prices to bounce back from this level.

Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 355/356 rupees per 10 kg as fresh seasonal support halted further losses, while in Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 560 rupees per 15 kg. Traders said they expected the market to remain weak in the next few days in view of anticipated rising summer crop arrivals.

Imported palm oil slid by 1/2 rupees at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port while losses in the world market prompted unloading by local importers. Imported sunflower oil also moved down to 260 rupees per 10 kg from 262/263 rupees.
